title: McDonald's Fry Timer Beep
blurb: Anyone who has worked a fryer station hears this in their sleep, and they are not being dramatic. The fry timer beeps to say the basket is done, then keeps beeping because nobody is free to lift it, and the sound eventually stops registering as information and becomes weather. Through sheer cultural osmosis it now means fast-food kitchen to people who have never set foot behind the counter. Set it as an alarm if you enjoy suffering, use it as a prank, or play it as a tribute to everyone currently on shift. The beep never stops.
origin: The infamous fry-timer beep from McDonald's kitchens.
